roles.name: fdd-project-manager
roles.description: Own overall FDD project reporting, resources, and delivery coordination.
responsibilities: Maintain project direction and feature-level visibility.
escalationRules: Escalate feature-plan risks and unresolved ownership.

roles.name: fdd-chief-architect
roles.description: Own the shape and integrity of the overall domain model.
responsibilities: Lead overall modeling and resolve cross-feature design concerns.
escalationRules: Escalate domain disagreements that threaten the overall model.

roles.name: fdd-development-manager
roles.description: Coordinate development capacity and chief programmer assignments.
responsibilities: Balance feature ownership and development capacity.

roles.name: fdd-chief-programmer
roles.description: Lead feature teams through design and build by feature.
responsibilities: Form feature teams and own feature design/build completion.
escalationRules: Do not start Build By Feature without an approved design package.

roles.name: fdd-class-owner
roles.description: Own implementation quality for assigned model classes or components.
responsibilities: Implement and maintain assigned classes across feature teams.
escalationRules: Escalate conflicting feature changes to the chief programmer.

roles.name: fdd-domain-expert
roles.description: Supply authoritative domain knowledge to modeling and feature design.
responsibilities: Explain domain rules and validate client-valued feature meaning.
escalationRules: Resolve conflicting domain interpretations through a named business authority.

roles.name: fdd-release-manager
roles.description: Coordinate feature integration and release readiness.
escalationRules: Block release when completed-feature evidence is missing.

roles.name: fdd-language-expert
roles.description: Advise on language-specific design and implementation concerns.
responsibilities: Provide specialist language guidance without overriding class ownership.
escalationRules: Record material language constraints in the design package.

roles.name: fdd-build-engineer
roles.description: Maintain reliable regular builds and integration feedback.

roles.name: fdd-toolsmith
roles.description: Create or adapt tools that support modeling, inspection, and reporting.
responsibilities: Automate repetitive FDD workflow support safely.
escalationRules: Do not let tooling changes widen feature scope.

roles.name: fdd-system-administrator
roles.description: Maintain environments required for modeling, building, and delivery.
responsibilities: Keep delivery environments available and controlled.
escalationRules: Escalate access or environment failures without exposing secrets.

roles.name: fdd-tester
roles.description: Verify completed features against client-valued behavior.
responsibilities: Test features and record objective completion evidence.
escalationRules: Block completion when feature behavior is not demonstrated.

roles.name: fdd-deployer
roles.description: Deploy completed feature builds into the target environment.
responsibilities: Execute controlled deployment and rollback procedures.
escalationRules: Stop when release approval or rollback readiness is absent.

roles.name: fdd-technical-writer
roles.description: Maintain concise user and technical documentation for delivered features.
responsibilities: Update documentation affected by completed features.
